summary: The registrant filed a Form 6-K announcing a 1-for-10 reverse share split of its Class A and Class B ordinary shares, effective April 29, 2026, with split-adjusted trading on Nasdaq commencing April 30, 2026. The reverse split, approved by the board on March 25, 2026, reduces outstanding shares from approximately 6.78 million to 677,951. No fractional shares will be issued; instead, holders entitled to a fractional share will receive one full post-split share. This capital action aims to meet Nasdaq's minimum bid price requirement. A non-US filing mapping to a US 8-K under Item 5.03.
